I'm sorry, nothing has reached you yet, and it should have. That's on us, not you.

The C. versus FCC marking on the radio module, the certificate number and the declaration of conformity are back in front of the team with your email on it. It's Saturday here, so they pick it up Monday at 10am ET and send it to (email hidden) No need to wait in the chat.

Don't order the 40T until you have that paperwork in hand.
I'll leave you to it. Come back here once you have the paperwork and your partner's decision, and I'll set the cart up for you.
I do not want to lose this batch

Batch 8 is still open right now, 50 units at $799, ships December 7. I can't put one aside, and I can't tell you how fast it goes.

Straight answer: the only way to secure a unit is to order it. But you told me you can't import it without the CE and radio certificate, so buying before that answer arrives is a real risk, and a pre-order isn't something I'd want you stuck with.

Here's the link when you're ready: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/magic-miner-40t
Is the BOM has CEO or FCC ?

That's the same question I can't answer without guessing, and I won't guess on a document customs will read. The listing gives specs, not the marking or the certificate number on the Wi-Fi module.

It's already with the team with your email on it. They're offline until Monday 10am ET, and the answer goes to (email hidden) then.

If it helps your partner decide meanwhile: the 40T runs fully wired over RJ45, so the radio can stay off entirely.
What will happen if i order and find out there is no CE or FCC ?

Honest answer: I can't promise you an outcome, and I won't invent one. A pre-order means a unit gets built and allocated to you, so unwinding it isn't automatic, it's a decision the team makes case by case.

Which is exactly why I'd wait. Get the marking and the certificate in writing Monday, then order with your eyes open. The batch may still be there, and if it isn't, another one follows.

Don't spend $799 on a maybe.
That's the sensible call. Watch (email hidden) Monday, and come back here once you have it. I'll build the cart for you then.
